trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident **INC-0002**, which paged on-call.

1. **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The test build before it (v2.3.1-rc) was also marked unhealthy, so v2.3.0 is the most recent healthy release.
2. **Rollback:** All three regions are now on v2.3.0. The service reports healthy and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
3. **Incident:** The first attempt to open it timed out. I checked the incident list, confirmed it hadn't been created, then retried so on-call wouldn't get two pages. INC-0002 says what failed, what I rolled back and how the service looks now. It also notes that someone needs to find why v2.3.1 broke before it's deployed again.
